section_summary.extract_value: This section details the examination of self-efficacy generality and intensity in a study comparing variable and constant practice conditions. Hypothesis 2a, predicting higher self-efficacy generality in the variable condition, was supported by factor analyses, intercorrelations, and repeated measures analyses. Hypothesis 2b, predicting higher self-efficacy intensity in the constant condition, was not supported. Hypotheses 3a and 3b, regarding training performance variability as a mediator, were also not supported.
